findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "apply_as_partner" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this only when a content or UGC creator, an educator or coach, an owner-creator or a social media manager wants to apply to Suara's partner program (https:/…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "connect_social_account" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: apply_as_partner, holiday_calendar, get_my_brand, get_my_posts, send_to_suara, get_suara_replies, my_social_accounts, my_instagram_insights, post_stats, get_my_week, my_best_times · Private data: festive_calendar, connect_social_account, add_photo, my_plan · Public sink: apply_as_partner, make_sample_posts, best_time_to_post, festive_calendar, restaurant_index, get_my_posts, send_to_suara, approve_post, my_social_accounts, my_instagram_insights, post_stats, get_my_week, reschedule_post, cancel_post, request_post_change, add_style_note · Destructive: apply_as_partner.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: apply_as_partner, holiday_calendar, get_my_brand, get_my_posts, send_to_suara, get_suara_replies, my_social_accounts, my_instagram_insights, post_stats, get_my_week, my_best_times · Private data: festive_calendar, connect_social_account, add_photo, my_plan · Public sink: apply_as_partner, make_sample_posts, best_time_to_post, festive_calendar, restaurant_index, get_my_posts, send_to_suara, approve_post, my_social_accounts, my_instagram_insights, post_stats, get_my_week, reschedule_post, cancel_post, request_post_change, add_style_note · Destructive: apply_as_partner

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
